restoration_steps: Step 1: Immediately scale down production deployment to 0 replicas
Step 2: Activate hot standby database from backup (point-in-time recovery)
Step 3: Restore previous model version from container registry
Step 4: Route all traffic back to previous production version
Step 5: Verify health checks passing on restored production
Step 6: Enable read-only mode for data team to investigate issue
Step 7: Activate incident response protocol: Brief CRO and Board
Step 8: Document incident: root cause, impact, resolution
Step 9: Schedule post-incident review within 48 hours
